intro: Describe the diagram in Mermaid-like text. Rhumb draws it as a block diagram that follows the selected standard.

syntax.title: Structure
syntax.header: Start with flowchart (or graph) and a direction: TD, TB, BT, LR or RL.
syntax.chain: Connect blocks with arrows. Chains work: A --> B --> C.
syntax.label: Label a line with |text| or -- text -->.
syntax.comment: Lines that start with %% are comments.

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.text: Label the branches Yes and No. The profile decides which corner each one leaves from; unlabeled branches use the free corners in order.

loops.title: Loops
loops.text: A preparation block that the flow returns to becomes a loop header: the body leaves from the bottom, the return enters one side corner and the exit leaves from the opposite one.

standards.title: Standards
standards.text: A standard is a JSON profile with block sizes, line widths, fonts and branch sides. Pick a built-in one on the Config tab or load your own.
